about.title: About MedGift US
about.intro: We connect surplus medical equipment with people and clinics who need it — cutting waste, empowering communities, and building a greener care ecosystem.
manifesto.title: THE MEDGIFT MANIFESTO: Reuse, Empower, Heal the Planet
manifesto.subtitle: A clear promise for donors, recipients, and partners who believe medical care and planetary care belong together.
manifesto.lead: Every year, thousands of fully functional medical devices are left unused in storage, while millions of individuals with disabilities lack access to essential mobility equipment. MedGift US bridges this gap by turning unused medical items into life-changing mobility solutions.
manifesto.pillar1Body: Every year, thousands of fully functional medical devices gather dust in storage while millions lack basic mobility. We end this cycle of waste by reclaiming usable equipment and connecting it directly with those in need—stopping overconsumption at its root.
manifesto.pillar2Body: A global, transparent solidarity network built by and for the disability community. We break down financial barriers and offer dignified, peer-to-peer access to mobility tools, ensuring no one is left behind.
manifesto.pillar3Body: Medical equipment recycling is clean energy in action. By extending the lifecycle of existing items, we cut factory emissions, reduce electronic and plastic waste, and track real-time CO2 savings on our live ESG dashboard.
manifesto.ctaBody: Join us in turning idle equipment into freedom, dignity, and a greener planet.
manifesto.detail1Body: The world turns every day in a frenzy of overconsumption. On one side, hundreds of thousands of life-saving medical devices left to gather dust in storage—still working like new. On the other, millions of people with disabilities forced to stay home because they cannot access a single wheelchair, walker, or care supply. We are here to stop this injustice. MedGift US pulls every working idle medical item out of landfills and warehouses and connects it directly with those who need it. We end waste and turn reuse into a way of life.
manifesto.detail2Intro: This is not just a charity project; it is a global solidarity network built among people with disabilities and their families.
manifesto.detail2Bullet1: A Community That Turns Recipients Into Leaders: The person in need is no longer a passive recipient, but an actor at the center of this solidarity.
manifesto.detail2Bullet2: Fearless and Free Movement: Sharing a single device means someone can go to school, join work, go outside, and breathe freely.
manifesto.detail2Bullet3: Safe and Dignified Access: Without middlemen, with transparency, 48-hour fair reservation, and secure communication, everyone reaches what they need with the respect they deserve.
manifesto.detail3Intro: Every newly manufactured medical device means tons of carbon emissions, factory smoke, and plastic/metal waste left in nature. MedGift US treats medical recycling as the cleanest form of energy!
manifesto.detail3Bullet1: Zero Out the Carbon Footprint: By putting existing working devices back into circulation, we reduce the need for new production and factory emissions.
manifesto.detail3Bullet2: Live ESG Metrics: We account for every device returned to beneficial use and every kilogram of CO₂ emissions prevented—with our live counters.

aiSupport.title: MedGift AI Assistant - 7/24 Support
aiSupport.welcome: Hello! I am your MedGift Assistant. How can I help you today with donating, requesting equipment, or navigating our platform?
aiSupport.reply.request: Of course — I’m here with you. To request equipment: open the Recipient tab, browse or search items, tap a listing to see distance and sizing, then reserve it. If nothing matches, use Add to Wishlist so Instant Match can alert you when a similar donation is listed.
aiSupport.reply.donate: Donating is simple and meaningful. Go to DME or Wound Care, fill in condition, ZIP, sizing (for DME), and handoff options, then submit. You’ll get a printable QR donation label for secure delivery confirmation — and your impact appears on the ESG dashboard.
aiSupport.reply.reservation: The 48-hour reservation rule protects fairness. When you reserve an item, it is held for you for 48 hours so you can arrange pickup or meetup. If the hold expires without confirmation, the item returns to the available list for others in need.
aiSupport.reply.shipping: Shipping depends on the donor’s handoff choice. Listings show Pickup Only, Assistance Available, or Meetup Possible. Check the badge on the item card or detail page — many donors can help load equipment or meet halfway. Coordinate safely in Secure Chat after reserving.
aiSupport.reply.esg: Every reuse helps the planet. Our Impact & ESG Dashboard (Home and Profile) tracks medical equipment saved, estimated CO₂ avoided (kg), and community savings ($). It’s live — it updates as donations and listings grow.
aiSupport.reply.complaint: I’m sorry you’re dealing with a frustrating experience — that matters to us. Please use Partner with Us / Contact Us to send a sponsorship or support inquiry, or describe what went wrong here and I’ll guide you to the right next step (reservation, delivery QR, or admin message).
aiSupport.reply.navigate: Happy to guide you. Main areas: Home (impact + quick actions), DME / Wound Care (donate), Recipient (browse & reserve), Exchange, Profile (wishlist, receipts, alerts), and My Items. Tell me what you’re trying to do and I’ll point you there.
aiSupport.reply.fallback: Thank you for reaching out — I’m listening. I can help with requesting equipment, donating, the 48-hour reservation rule, pickup/meetup options, ESG impact, or navigating MedGift. Try a quick question chip below, or tell me in your own words.

fda.guidelinesIntro: Complete this short checklist before handing off any medical device. It helps protect recipients and keeps MedGift listings trustworthy.
fda.guidelineClean: Clean and disinfect all touch surfaces with device-safe cleaners. Allow parts to dry fully.
fda.guidelineInspect: Inspect frame, brakes, straps, motors, tubing, and seals for cracks, wear, or missing fasteners.
fda.guidelineLabel: Photograph or note the manufacturer label (brand, model, serial) and confirm it matches your listing.
fda.guidelineAccessories: Include working accessories needed for safe use (chargers, footrests, tubing) or disclose if missing.
fda.guidelineRecall: Confirm the brand/model is not under an active FDA recall. MedGift blocks recalled models automatically.
fda.snackRecallBlocked: Listing blocked: this model has an active FDA recall notice.
